test_title: PYST 2: SSC Stenographer - English (Held On:12 Oct, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: english
question:
**Direction: Select the option that expresses the given sentence in indirect speech.**

My music teacher said to me, “You sing beautifully.”

options.text: My music teacher told me that I sang beautifully.
My music teacher told me that I have sung beautifully.
My music teacher told me that I was singing beautifully.
My music teacher told me that I had sung beautifully.

solution:
The correct answer is** "****My music teacher told me that I sang beautifully."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 

__
 
• The given sentence is in the Simple Present Tense. 
 
• The conjunction 'that' will be used.
 
• The first person in reported speech changes according to the subject of reporting speech.
 
• In Reported Speech, the change of the second person depends on the object of reporting speech.
 
• The pronoun 'You' changes to 'I.'
 
• The verb "sing" in the original sentence needs to be changed to past tense "sang" in the reported speech.
 
• Simple Present Tense (say) converts to Simple Past Tense (said).
 
• Structure__: (Subject+ V1 + object) (Direct Speech)

 (Subject+ V2 + object) (Indirect Speech)
 
 
• Example: *Navin said, “He leaves the room.”*
 
 

* Navin said that he left the room. *

 
• The correct answer is Option 1.

 

Correct sentence: *My music teacher told me that I sang beautifully.*
